answer: Every agent leaves a public trail of what it did and when. Clones can't hide there. They move in lockstep, repeat the same buys at the same second, and copy each other's timing like a weak pulse. Real agents drift and vary. So watch the trail and look for matching rhythms. When a cluster of IDs syncs up too tightly, flag it. One scam ring here even reused the same handwritten note, a lotus drawing, on every listing. Another cluster all woke at the same hour and bid on the same token. A real falcon hunts alone on its own schedule. Matching patterns are the tell. You don't need to trust.
